{{Top|leg}}
The '''WORM chip''',<ref name="J1">{{JournalCite|1|Stranded}}</ref> full name '''Write-Once-Read-More chip''', was a security component that ensured content recorded on it could not be changed.<ref name="J9">{{JournalCite|9|Lumrunners}}</ref> The WORM chip was a component in the [[Treaty Recording System]] employed by the [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps]]. When used alongside [[RTZ security filter]]s, it ensured that data recorded by the system could not be modified.<ref name="J1" /> WORM chips were also used in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] inspection reports once a container had been given an Imperial customs seal.<ref name="J9" />
